title: Shard Stack
gameplaySummary: What Makes It Unique Shard Stack must be clearly different from every nearby mode: Shard Stack must be clearly different from every nearby mode: unlike Tile Shift, players do not manipulate the whole board. They place one shape at a time.unlike Clear Rush, removal comes from completed rows/zones, not tap-clears.unlike Spatial Spin, rotation supports shape fit, but the identity is queue-based placement.unlike Link Lock / Circuit Clash / Pipe Pulse, there is no route-building or flow logic.unlike Score Attack / Combo Rush, no cluster solving is involved.unlike Maze Rush / Mirror Maze, there is no navigation or beam pathing. unlike Tile Shift, players do not manipulate the whole board. They place one shape at a time. | Win: Win Condition A player wins by: A player wins by: | Players: 4

effects.notes: Crisp snap FX on placement. Brief, satisfying.
Short shake animation on piece. Red flash feedback.
Zone area dissolves with a flash and radiates outward.
Penalty block flies to opponent board.

spriteSheets.phaserUsage: frame index per slot state drawn to grid
spriteSheets.styleNotes: Clean geometric slot recess. Dark inset, subtle grid lines. Hover state = subtle cyan edge. Valid target = brighter edge. Invalid = red edge.
spriteSheets.gameplayReadabilityNotes: Slot boundaries must be clearly visible to guide placement decisions.

spriteSheets.phaserUsage: per-piece type, animated states via frame ranges
spriteSheets.styleNotes: Solid color block with inner chamfer/bevel edge. Glossy hard-surface. Per-piece color identity: each piece type has distinct color family. Held state: slight float effect + drop shadow. Snap: bright edge flash.
spriteSheets.gameplayReadabilityNotes: Block shapes must be read at a glance. Shape identity (L, T, I, S, Z) must survive small scale.

spriteSheets.phaserUsage: played once centered on cleared zone, scaled to fit zone size
spriteSheets.styleNotes: Large burst covering completed zone area. Bright white flash → cyan spread → fade. Geometric angular shards fly outward. Premium, crisp, celebratory.
spriteSheets.gameplayReadabilityNotes: Must not persist longer than 0.5s. Board must be readable immediately after.
